items.title: Paysign is a Sponsor at the 2026 International Plasma Protein Therapeutics Conference, Milan, Italy
items.summary: Paysign is excited to be a sponsor at the Plasma Protein Therapeutics Association 2026 International Plasma Protein Congress held on April 28-29 in Milan, Italy. This conference will explore the plasma industry, the need to increase plasma collection, patient health, safety, and the developments within regulatory and policy categories.
